confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of tourist-area prices, not checked against live listings or July 2026 quotes. Food and beer anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies by district and season; July is low season, so room rates lean low. Cocktail and wine are set at 2.5 times the beer anchor because direct knowledge of their prices is weak. FX: the 14 Oct 2026 RBA figure comes from search summaries that I did not open directly, and the sources conflicted (an older RBA-attributed 20 Mar 2026 value; a third-party 0.6971 for 14 Oct), so verify the RBA table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Southeast Asian leisure hubs that price largely in US dollars, with a tourist-district premium over local neighbourhoods; loosely benchmarked against tourist areas of Phnom Penh and Luang Prabang.
